data.one_liner: Utilities for unit testing Dart build_runner builders in memory
data.what_it_does: Provides helper functions to run builders in RAM, resolve source code, and read generated assets. It supports in-memory builds, real source files, and asset resolution via analyzer.
use_when: Need to resolve Dart source during tests
avoid_when: Production code that needs to run on device or web
When you only need to generate code without testing
strengths: Runs builds entirely in memory, fast and isolated
Supports real source files via TestReaderWriter
Built-in helpers for resolving source code with analyzer
Easy to read generated assets as strings
weaknesses: Only works with build_runner; not for general code generation
Requires Dart 3.11+ and specific build_runner versions
Limited to builder testing, not general utilities
data.setup_notes: Add dependency, import build_test, call testBuilder or testBuilders; no extra permissions needed
